name: AIPL Autograph
summary: Project, developer (Advance India Projects Ltd), Sector 66 Golf Course Extension Road location, RERA GGM/481/213/2021/49 and 6.13-acre land area are confirmed. Starting price varies widely across sources (₹65 L broker vs ₹1.15 Cr Houssed vs ₹2.85 Cr Square Yards), construction status is reported inconsistently (under construction vs ready to move), and floors are given as 11 or G+12/G+5/G+8 rather than a single 12. Possession (Oct 2025 / Apr 2026 per brokers) is not on our page.
